crossRefs.note: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed…
David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments…
Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for…
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and…
Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: Heman
people.line: A Levite and chief musician in David's time.

people.name: Jeduthun
people.line: Levitical musician and singer during David's reign

translations.web: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
translations.bsb: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
translations.kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
translations.asv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed with cymbals of brass to sound aloud;
